decisions.reason: The black border is explicitly limited to the zebra design; the basket-weave print has its own separately specified very fine mustard edge.
Adding a black border to the zebra artwork does not change the production-readiness, CMYK, or seamless-repeat file requirements.
The source decision applies specifically to the zebra print and does not modify the mustard block-colour pareo, whose black border was already established.
